definitions.short: a pot or furnace (as if excavated)
definitions.full: H3564. kuwr כּוּר noun [masculine] smelting-pot or furnace (Arabic ; Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic id. , ; Ethiopic ) — pot or furnace for smelting metals, but always in metaphor or simile of human sufferings in punishment or discipline: iron (figurative of Egypt as place of bondage) ׳מִכּ הַבַּרְזֶל Deut 4:20 ; Jer 11:4 , כ ׳מִתּוֺךְ ׳הַבּ 1Kin 8:51 ; gold ׳כ לַזָּהָב Prov 17:3 = 27:21 (|| מַצְרֵף ); various metals Ezek 22:18 , 20 , 22 ; once עֹ֑נִי בְּכוּר Isa 48:10 in a smelting-pot of affliction.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through;
